text: Dr. Tiffany Arroyo has 19 claims dated after credential CRD_002042 was revoked on 2025-08-03, beginning 35 days after revocation. Nineteen claims is toward the upper end of what ordinarily-rostered revoked doctors reach here, but it does not clear the volume threshold that separates administrative lag from deliberate continuation, so the alert stays low. The steady pace over several months is the detail worth noting — a paperwork tail usually decays quickly. The honest alternative is a clinic that simply failed to re-verify its roster for a season. Next step: confirm the rostering clinic's verification date; a stand-down after 2025-08 would convert this from noise to a pattern.
